about_pullquote: I started this to do the job properly — no cutting corners, fair pricing.
about_para_1: KR Electrical Contractors was founded on the principle that every customer deserves honest, professional electrical work. Over eighteen years, we've built our reputation on showing up on time, diagnosing faults accurately, and finishing what we start. All our work meets or exceeds Building Regulations, and we never pressure customers into work they don't need.
about_para_2: Southampton homeowners and businesses trust us because we listen first and give straightforward advice. Whether it's an emergency call-out at 2am or a planned rewire, we treat your home or building with respect. Many of our customers have come back to us year after year — that's the real measure of our success.

reviews.text: Had a major electrical fault that left half the house without power. Called KR at 9pm and they had someone round by 10:15. The lad was calm, diagnosed it straight away, and got us back online. Really impressed with the speed and the knowledge. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed a full rewire and were nervous about the cost and disruption. KR gave us a clear quote, stuck to it, and the team worked around us without any fuss. They tidied up after themselves and left us with all the paperwork. Top-notch service.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Second time using KR now. First time was an emergency socket repair, this time a new cooker circuit. Always punctual, always friendly, and they explain what they're doing so you understand it. Will call them again.
reviews.author: James K.
